parameters.name: NameMatchType
parameters.description:
The search match mode for the SaaS domain name. Default value: exact. Valid values:
- **prefix**: prefix match.
- **suffix**: suffix match.
- **exact**: exact match.
- **fuzzy**: fuzzy match.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number for a paged query. The value must be greater than or equal to 1.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page for a paged query. Valid values: 1 to 500.

parameters.name: RecordId
parameters.description: The associated record ID. You can call the [ListRecords](~~2850265~~) operation to obtain the record ID.

parameters.name: SiteId
parameters.description: The site ID. You can call the [ListSites](~~2850189~~) operation to obtain the site ID.

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description:
The SaaS domain name status. Valid values:
- **pending**: pending verification.
- **active**: activated.
- **conflicted**: occupied.
- **offline**: offline.
